description: Find and replace text within a note body. Supports literal and regex search, case sensitivity, whole-word matching, and a replacement limit. Frontmatter is never touched. Use dryRun to preview matches before writing.

dryRun.description: If true, report matches without writing. Default false.

limit.description: Maximum number of replacements. Omit to replace all.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

regex.description: Treat find as a regular expression. Default false.

replace.description: Replacement text. Supports $1, $2, … backreferences in regex mode.

wholeWord.description: Match whole words only (\b boundary). Default false.

name: replace_in_note
